facts.business: NCC Limited is an Indian infrastructure and construction company headquartered in Hyderabad, operating across seven verticals: Buildings, Transportation, Water & Environment, Electrical (T&D), Irrigation, Railways and Mining.
facts.related_party_note: Transactions with the related parties are in compliance with section 177 and 188 of Companies Act, 2013 where applicable and the details have been disclosed in the notes to the standalone Ind AS financial statements, as required by the applicable accounting standards.
